text:
ITEM 1 | Scrambled egg-like mass, pale yellow with lighter cream patches and small soft curds, moist-looking, piled in a loose mound about 7 cm across and 1.5 cm high, topped and mixed with thin orange shreds of cheese that look melted in places, sitting at the upper left of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Orange shredded cheese, bright orange thin strands about 0.3 cm wide and 4 to 6 cm long, partly melted and clumped over the scrambled mass and scattered onto the plate edge | 30
ITEM 3 | Cooked bacon strips, reddish-brown with darker crisp edges and glossy fat streaks, lying in overlapping strips about 1 cm wide and 10 cm long, spanning the center of the plate beneath and beside the eggs | 45
ITEM 4 | Round sliced sausage pieces, dark reddish-brown with browned, slightly shiny skin and cut faces showing a darker interior, each slice about 3 cm across and 1 cm thick, placed at the right side of the plate | 35
ITEM 5 | Pineapple chunks, pale yellow with slightly darker golden edges, firm and moist-looking, cut into cubes about 2.5 cm on a side with flat cut faces, arranged in a row along the lower left of the plate | 85
ITEM 6 | Brussels sprouts halves, dark green with browned, charred outer leaves and lighter cut faces, roughly 2 cm across, scattered in the lower center near the pineapple | 35
ITEM 7 | Roasted potato cubes, golden-brown with crisp, slightly browned exterior and pale cream interior, cut into cubes about 2 cm on a side with some irregular edges, clustered at the lower right of the plate | 60
